name: SGLang time-to-first-token histogram (is_streaming split)
notes: SGLang main, python/sglang/srt/observability/metrics_collector.py, read 2026-10-04. NOT ON BY DEFAULT: nothing is exported unless --enable-metrics (ServerArgs default False), which is also the only thing that mounts /metrics on the server port. Label keys are model_name, engine_type, tp_rank, pp_rank, moe_ep_rank (plus dp_rank under data parallelism, priority under priority scheduling, and anything in extra_metric_labels). Bucket ladders are overridable per histogram via get_histogram_conf_from_env. Carries an is_streaming label that vLLM has no equivalent of. The source comment explains the name: 'stream' is a reserved thrift keyword, so downstream storage columns cannot carry it. Definition from the docs: time from request creation in the API server to the first token, and for streaming requests it ends when the first output arrives AFTER detokenization - so a detokenizer stall lands inside TTFT.
